slashdashed_node.comment: Matches a slashdashed node with its stages, including stages on the following lines. The KDL grammar's node slashdash ends at the end of the line, and only covers a single token after { or ;.
slashdashed_node.name: comment.block.slashdash.kdl

slashdashed_string.comment: Skips strings, so a ; or brace inside one doesn't end the slashdashed node.

slashdashed_children.comment: Skips a children block, which can span lines.

slashdashed_trailing_pipe.comment: A #> at the end of a line continues the chain on the next line, up to the next stage's name.

slashdashed_stage.comment: Matches a slashdashed stage up to the next stage, the end of the node, or the end of the line. A stage whose #> ends a line continues on the next line. The KDL grammar's inline slashdash only covers a single token.
slashdashed_stage.name: comment.block.slashdash.kdl

pipe.comment: Matches #> and the next stage's name, with an optional type annotation before the name.
